pyq_bad.why: mental ability: Venn-diagram item, figure missing

patterns: PYQs are scheme-identification one-liners (RSBY as a social protection programme; Atal Pension Yojana in Budget 2015-16).
Likely APPSC shapes: scheme -> age band / benefit, e-Shram launch and eligibility, NCEUS chair.
Common traps: 18-40 vs 18-50 age bands (PMJJBY only 18-50); NPS/EPFO/ESIC members excluded from PM-SYM.
App MCQs go deeper into Labour Code thresholds (300 / 50 / 60-14 days) than any PYQ shows, but are factually sound.
